WITH order_avg AS (
  SELECT ordersmark AS ref, AVG(fillcount) AS avg_fill
  FROM orderexecutions
  WHERE ordersmark IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ordersmark
  HAVING AVG(fillcount) IS NOT NULL
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_fill) AS overall_avg FROM order_avg
),
kept AS (
  SELECT o.ref, o.avg_fill
  FROM order_avg o
  CROSS JOIN overall v
  WHERE o.avg_fill > v.overall_avg
),
kept_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_fill) AS kept_mean FROM kept
)
SELECT k.ref,
       k.avg_fill,
       k.avg_fill - v.overall_avg AS diff_overall,
       k.avg_fill - ka.kept_mean AS diff_kept
FROM kept k
CROSS JOIN overall v
CROSS JOIN kept_avg ka
WHERE ka.kept_mean IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY (k.avg_fill - ka.kept_mean) IS NULL, (k.avg_fill - ka.kept_mean) DESC
LIMIT 10
